method: supervised candidate task ranking with persistent goals and autoregressive market cloning
rank_sample_weight: inverse sqrt positive action frequency capped 8; first 3 days times 4
negative_sampling: always WAIT plus hard spatial/action negatives
execution_guard: block duplicate held-item pickup and immediate shed transfer reversal; allow productive animal placement and end-of-day return
seed_stock_guard: Cap each crop seed stock after our market orders at current worker count; no final-turn buys; fixed-price seeds need no speculative inventory.
